verdict.rationale: Calendly Workflows explicitly automate pre- and post-meeting emails and texts to invitees, hosts, and teammates, which covers reminder and follow-up sequences over both email and SMS around bookings. The evidence is a single first-party marketing statement, so depth is thin. Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring sequence timing and multiple steps, evidence that workflows fire automatically on every booking or event type, any no-show reduction data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
